# FI0-10146 — Add NMD fields to StorageDocument JSON sent to Strategic Reporting

## User story

As the FES core system

I want the new NMD fields to be added to the JSON file sent to Strategic Reporting (SR)

So that the fields can be used by Strategic Reporting.

## Acceptance criteria

### Scenario 1 — place of unloading mapped

Given I have completed my non-manipulation document

When I select "Accept and create catch storage document"

Then the field `placeofUnloading` will contain the place of unloading provided on one of the following pages:

- `/add-arrival-transportation-details-truck`
- `/add-arrival-transportation-details-plane`
- `/add-arrival-transportation-details-train`
- `/add-arrival-transportation-details-container-vessel`

### Scenario 2 — issuing country field added

Given I have completed my non-manipulation document

When I select "Accept and create catch storage document"

Then the field `issuingCountry` and its data appear in the `products` section of the CreateStorageDocument.json file sent to Strategic Reporting.

And the value should be:

- the Issuing Country provided on `/add-product-to-this-consignment` when the user answers "Was the catch certificate issued in the UK?" with "No"; or
- the literal string `United Kingdom` when the user answers "Was the catch certificate issued in the UK?" with "Yes".

## Technical details
- Add above fields by using following prompt `mmo-fes-reference-data-reader/.github/prompts/add-new-field-to-SR.prompt.md`
- `placeofUnloading` in `arrivalTransportation` interface and it's is an optional
- `issuingCountry` in `products` interface and it's an optional
- `placeofUnloading` and `issuingCountry` should be added in in `/test/landings/transformations/defraValidationReport.spec.ts` to update tests for the modified files without removing existing test logic.
